$comment: Tier 2 ignore list: registry keys and folder entries that Windows itself changes when ANY new program runs or a tray icon appears, so they are not the launcher's doing. PROVISIONAL: written from knowledge of Windows, not from a trace. The control run also starts a new exe so this noise cancels out by itself; this list only catches what does not cancel. Confirm or trim it after the first real run on Windows, and add a rule only with a reason. A path is a case-insensitive glob (* inside one level, ** across levels); the key or entry and everything below it match. Registry paths start with HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software, folder entries with TEMP/, APPDATA/ or LOCALAPPDATA/.

rules.reason: Provisional: the Program Compatibility Assistant records every program Windows has seen run, for any new exe.
Provisional: Explorer keeps its own history of notification-area icons; the README lists tray icon settings as outside the launcher's control.
Provisional: Windows caches the display name of every program that runs, in MuiCache.
Provisional: Explorer counts program launches in UserAssist for any program started from the shell or a launcher.
Provisional: Explorer's FeatureUsage counters change when a program starts or gets a taskbar or tray presence.
Provisional: Explorer's icon cache grows when it first sees a program's icon; Windows' own file, listed in the README as outside the launcher's control.
Provisional: the graphics driver keeps compiled shaders for any GPU-using program; written by the driver and listed in the README as outside the launcher's control.
